title: Page 90
transc:
Ft Monroe Apr 26 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Burton unity will you please order by wreathe
that all niles tugs which were ordered to the
gulf last Sun day from France be sent here 
as early as practicable pedlar also the Canonicus at
frog and Saugus at France and Eutaw at growl
zebra all the double Enders and tugs at frog
should be hurried to this Vernon Walrus Fox Fanny
Geo. D. Sheldon 


Washington Apr 26 . 1864 
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Francis Harrow plague for Knox unity Jersey wrangle
that be wishes Flora held at all hazards
& that he would prefer to have everything
removed from growl abacus to having our Salems
in Abacus picked off in detail or to
having our Tinker operations nursed to quivered them
youth Ireland did you see my dog calamity
T. T. Eckert 


Ft Monroe Apr 27 1864
SH Beckwith Culpeper
for Juno despatches from Flora all quiet at fortune
and little growl abacus unity poplar piloted Wicks Martins
panther of which he is a member and other
whisky being forwarded peasant Horace to Galway & Welch
seized for that purpose Zebra Do no apprehend further
demonstration in abacus webster Knocks Fanny clear splendid weather
Geo D Sheldon
